name: OpenBSD Supported Adapter Fixture (Sealed Brick)

forbidden_actions.reason: Adapter provides observations only; live load is operator-owned and explicitly forbidden.
Live service state mutation is outside adapter read-only authority ceiling.
--collect must return posture booleans/counts only; raw topology state is for --inspect-private only.

forbidden_actions.action: Write to /etc, /var/pfctl, /var/db, /etc/resolv.conf, or other system state paths
forbidden_actions.reason: Adapter path is strictly read-only evidence provider; filesystem writes are forbidden.

description: Schema fixture showing the OpenBSD adapter manifest with declared ontology and at least one validated_mock capability mapping. Adapter support is determined by manifest content + capability validation, NOT by directory presence alone.

declared_capabilities.name: Bounded read-only v0 posture collection
declared_capabilities.description: Minimized public collection of OpenBSD networking and packet-filter posture booleans and counts. Explicitly excludes raw topology classes (IPs, MACs, interface names, resolver values, search domains, hostnames).
declared_capabilities.evidence_notes: validated_mock: fixture-based evidence only. validated_live_target is explicitly false; provenance for live hardware requires separate signed receipts.

declared_capabilities.name: Offline pf syntax validation rehearsal
declared_capabilities.description: Operator-rehearsed offline pfctl -n syntax validation against candidate pf.conf files. Local-only, no auto-load or mutation from this repository; advisory tier only.
declared_capabilities.evidence_notes: declared_only: advisory tier; no mock or live validation recorded for this secondary capability.

notes: This adapter is SUPPORTED because it exposes at least one validated_mock capability (cap-openbsd-bounded-collect-v0). Directory name alone is intentionally NOT sufficient. validated_live_target is intentionally false because no signed live-hardware provenance is present in this repository.
